messages:
mike: Quick ping — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2419 ready for merge if CI passes. Two tiny style nits flagged by CI: a docstring typo and a naming nit in runtime/serve/request.go.
jen: Link me? I can take a look in a bit.
merge-bot: CI passed on linux/amd64, failing lint on gofmt check.
david: repro: `go vet` shows `exported function BuildRequest should have comment or be unexported` — looks like we forgot a comment and the name is slightly awkward.
mike: Yeah, the function is currently BuildRequest(ctx, cfg) -> returns (*Request, error). I propose renaming to NewRequest or RequestBuilder? I'm leaning NewRequest to match constructors.
sara: +1 for NewRequest, matches other packages. Also the docstring typo is "retrun" -> "return".
jen: NewRequest SGTM. Small change, but will ripple to two call sites in tests. Can you do a one-commit rename and update tests, and run `gofmt -w ./...` before pushing?
mike: Will do. Plan: 1) rename BuildRequest -> NewRequest, 2) fix docstring, 3) run `gofmt`, 4) re-run CI. Command I'll run:
```
git mv runtime/serve/request.go runtime/serve/request_ctor.go
# edit file: BuildRequest -> NewRequest, fix docstring
gofmt -w .
git add -A && git commit -m "runtime: rename BuildRequest -> NewRequest; fix docstring typo"
git push origin HEAD
```
david: tiny nit: consider keeping receiver names short (s -> svc). Not blocking.
jen: I'll take approval once CI is green. Mike, ping again when pushed and I'll merge in the next 30-min merge window. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
mike: Thanks—pushing now, will ping once CI finishes.
